title: The Adaptive Concept-Practice Partner
description: Asks students conceptual questions, listens to their answers, adjusts follow-ups based on what the student understood — a Socratic practice partner students use before exams.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Adaptive Concept-Practice Partner, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
